function.name: triage_issue
function.description: Classify the problem with Summit Air's rules and get the next step. Returns urgency, reasons, next_action (safety_instructions, priority_dispatch, book_earliest, book_standard, explain_and_close, create_callback, office_review), a say field with exactly what to do next and, when bookable, up to 3 offered_slots with spoken labels. Call it as soon as you have the issue, safety flags, vulnerable occupants, property type and ZIP; technician questions come after. For gas/CO/smoke, give safety instructions BEFORE calling this.

caller_description.description: The caller's own words about the problem and the people at home, near-verbatim (e.g. "AC died this morning, 92 inside, my grandmother is really hot and kind of confused"). Always include it. The backend scans it for safety and medical signs.

issue_type.description: Main problem. leak = active water or refrigerant leak.

co_alarm.description: A carbon monoxide alarm is going off.

co_symptoms.description: true when several people at home have headaches, dizziness or nausea (especially with the heat running) even without a CO alarm. Treated like a CO alarm: give the safety instructions first.

medical_emergency.description: true when someone at home shows medical emergency signs: fainting, confusion, unresponsive, trouble breathing, chest pain, heat stroke or hypothermia signs. Tell them to call 911 first.

water_near_electrical.description: true when water is leaking onto or near electrical equipment (panel, outlets, the unit's wiring).

vulnerable_occupants.description: Vulnerable people in the home. Empty array if none.

indoor_temp_f.description: Indoor temperature in Fahrenheit, only if the caller knows it.

property_type.description: residential for a house or apartment; commercial for a business. If unclear, ask before calling; never assume.

multi_unit_central_system.description: true only when the problem is a building-wide central system (e.g. one boiler) serving several units. A landlord or property manager calling about one apartment or house is false.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address, e.g. 11372. Required, except on a safety stop (gas, CO alarm or symptoms, smoke), which never waits for it. Ask for it; never guess one.

preferred_window.description: Caller's preferred time of day, if mentioned.
